documentation.content: Runbook row: Job failure and missed schedule (MONITORING-RUNBOOK.md, Current-service signal plan). Responder: on-call API responder. One condition: a chirp-media-reconcile execution that completes with a result other than succeeded, in a 5-minute window. It can fire only for an execution that writes run.googleapis.com/job/completed_execution_count. On chirp-purge, executions that failed before any task started wrote no point at all, so this condition may be equally blind to that failure class here; that was observed on chirp-purge and has not been checked for this job. No missed-run detection exists for this job: no Cloud Scheduler cadence for it is checked in, and a daily cadence would hit the same 23h30m conditionAbsent ceiling recorded in MONITORING-RUNBOOK.md (c407). The 5-minute evaluation window is a judgment call, not a runbook-stated number. Initial, review after 7 days.

conditionThreshold.filter: resource.type="cloud_run_job" AND resource.labels.project_id="{{PROJECT}}" AND resource.labels.job_name="chirp-media-reconcile" AND metric.type="run.googleapis.com/job/completed_execution_count" AND metric.labels.result!="succeeded"
